reports_shell_copy: Understand net worth, spending, and cashflow from exact posted ledger data.
reports_net_worth_copy: Asset and liability value at each selected calendar bucket end.
reports_loading_copy: Reading exact balances from the posted ledger.
reports_error_copy: Refresh the report and try again.
reports_empty_copy: Post transactions in the selected period to see net worth over time.
reports_multi_commodity_notice: Totals are shown separately by commodity. Select a reporting currency in a future report to combine them.
import_shell_copy: Import transactions from QIF files exported by MS Money, Quicken, and other applications.
import_upload_copy: Choose a QIF file to import. You can export per-account QIF files from MS Money via File → Export → Loose QIF.
import_upload_ms_money_help: How to export from MS Money
import_upload_ms_money_steps: In MS Money: open the account → File → Export → choose Loose QIF → save and upload here.
import_preview_copy: Review the transactions below. Assign an account, currency, and default category to each import, then click Commit.
import_preview_no_rows: No transactions found in the file.
import_commit_reconciliation_override_hi: Allow imported rows to land inside already-reconciled periods. Use with care.
import_discard_confirm: Discard this import batch? The staged rows will be removed.
import_error_no_adapter: This file format is not supported. Please upload a QIF file.
reconcile_shell_copy: Match an account against a statement: clear the postings that appear on it, then finish when the difference is zero.
reconcile_start_copy: Pick an account, then enter the closing date and balance from your statement.
reconcile_start_no_accounts: No reconcilable accounts. Create a cash or liability account first.
reconcile_start_no_commodity: This account has no default currency. Set one on the account before reconciling it.
reconcile_start_balance_help: The closing balance shown on the statement, including a minus sign for a negative balance.
reconcile_start_invalid_balance: Enter a valid amount, for example 1234.56.
reconcile_session_copy: Tick each posting that appears on the statement. The difference updates as you go.
reconcile_session_empty_copy: There are no postings in this account for the statement period.
reconcile_session_error_copy: Something went wrong loading this reconciliation session.
reconcile_finish_hint: Finishing is available once the difference is zero.
reconcile_finished_copy: This account is reconciled through the statement date. A checkpoint was recorded.
reconcile_checkpoints_empty: This account has not been reconciled yet.
import_connections_copy: Connect an online provider to import transactions automatically.
import_connections_empty: No online connections. Add one below to import from Trading 212 or another provider.
import_connections_cash_account_error: Could not set the cash account.
import_connections_add_cash_account_help: Where BUY/SELL/DIVIDEND cash lands. Can be set or changed later.
import_connections_delete_confirm: Delete this connection? This does not affect already-imported transactions.
import_connections_auto_refresh_on: Auto-refresh is on. This connection fetches new activity automatically about once a day.
import_connections_auto_refresh_off: Auto-refresh is off. Use Refresh to fetch new activity manually.
import_connections_add_key_help: Generate an API key in the Trading 212 app under Settings → API.
import_connections_error_provider: The API key was rejected by Trading 212. Check the key and try again.
import_connections_error_config: The server is not configured for online connections. Set REKENRAAM_SECRET_KEY.
import_connections_error_duplicate: A connection with this name already exists.
import_connections_fetch_error: Could not start the fetch. Check the connection and try again.
import_fetching_copy: This can take a moment. You can leave this page; the fetch keeps running in the background.
import_fetching_failed_copy: Check the connection's API key and try again.
reports_net_worth_table_caption: Net worth at each period end, listed separately per commodity.
reports_spending_copy: Where money went over the selected period, ranked by amount.
reports_income_copy: Where money came from over the selected period, ranked by amount.
reports_spending_empty_copy: Post transactions with a category in the selected period to see where money went.
reports_spending_transfers_excluded: Transfers between your own accounts are not spending and are excluded, as is investment trade clearing.
reports_spending_multi_commodity_notice: Totals are shown separately by commodity, and shares compare only within a commodity. Rows are ordered by {commodity}.
reports_spending_table_caption: Totals per group, listed separately per commodity, with each group's share of its own commodity's total.
